description: Per-output-channel-scaled fp8 storage of the DENOISER's block Linears: the weight becomes F8_E4M3 at its own shape and grows an F32 [out] `weight_scale` DEQUANT multiplier; every other tensor, and every other component, is untouched at BF16. THE PREDICATE IS TRANSCRIBED FROM THE PRODUCER, not from a description of it: python-gen-worker `src/gen_worker/convert/writer.py:544` `w8a8_cast_eligible` — a rank-2 float `.weight`, both dims 16-aligned (torch._scaled_mm's `_DIM_ALIGN`), under a repeated-block path segment (`\.\d+\.`), whose module path misses every skip pattern. The skip list is split by how the producer ANCHORS it: `embed`/`norm`/... match anywhere, while `^proj_in$`, `^proj_out$` and `^proj$` match only a module path that IS that word — which is why SDXL's `down_blocks.{i}.attentions.{i}.proj_in` DOES convert. The base dtype is BF16 and that is a CONVENTION FACT, not an accident: cozy fp8 artifacts are requantized from the bf16 source, so an fp8 tree whose passthrough tensors are F16 is a different packaging and must not wear this stamp. `input_scale` is deliberately absent: activation scales are dynamic at serve time, so the producer emits none, and a tree carrying them is a different, statically calibrated layout. v2 (tensorfs#153) ADDS `adaln_proj` to the anywhere-match skips, and the addition is a TRANSCRIPTION, not a judgement: the producer takes invoke-supplied extra skip regexes (`w8a8_skip_patterns`, jobs conversion/src/conversion/transform.py, ie#681) precisely because the shared default knows `adaln_single` and not MiniMax-H3's `adaln_proj`, and a bare H3 run quantizes 50 modulation projections that te#171's AdaLN-skip precompute then reads as bf16 — garbage. The published H3 fp8-rowwise tree (tensorhub/minimax-h3 sha256:0601b889…) was produced WITH that widening: its 312 quantized tensors are the block attn/ff Linears of the transformer AND token-refiner blocks, and every adaln_proj.linear stays bf16 — measured, 950-tensor member, 312 F8 + 312 scales. No other shipped family spells any module `adaln_proj` (anima's quantized adaln_modulation_cross_attn does not contain it; sdxl and wan have no such module), so v2 computes a layout IDENTICAL to v1 on every topology except minimax-h3.diffusers — which is also why v1 is REPLACED rather than kept: two rules computing one layout would be two names for one packaging.
name: cozy.fp8-rowwise
